The **Amalgamation Core** is a pulsing arcane battery the size of a fist, recovered from the chest cavity of a defeated [[Amalgamation]]. It is geometric in shape, warm to the touch, and glows with a faint blue light. The core represents the [[Secretive Brotherhood]]'s most advanced construct-powering technology. It can be installed in a fortress to power permanent magical defenses or broken down into components for crafting uncommon magic items.
